    • RATE_NOTE

      public static final String RATE_NOTE
      Explains any rate in the same response that is null, or that had to be capped or read against a different denominator than usual. Absent when every rate was computed as it should be. An unknown rate must not be rendered as a zero.

      public static final int MAX_LENGTH_DEVICE_INFO_FIELD
